title: Read what the release checks measure
description: You can distinguish file-presence checks from verification of a language implementation's behavior.

steps.description: check prints a status and optional guidance, then returns the supplied Boolean. results collects those Booleans.
The first checks look for a README, five matching sample filenames, and a test file. They neither inspect setup text nor run the samples or tests.
The next checks require a semantics file above a byte threshold, a grammar filename, and an entry filename. Presence alone does not verify their contents agree.

steps.question: Which value decides whether the syntax check passes?
steps.answer: The py_compile subprocess must return exit code zero.

steps.description: The script attempts syntax compilation only when an entry file exists. Otherwise it records a failed check with guidance.
The supplied recording passes two of seven checks. Its five remaining items describe that run's directory, not a completed behavioral release test.
